disclaimer: This is orientation, not legal advice. Requirements vary by jurisdiction and must be verified with qualified legal, privacy, accessibility, institutional, and child-safety professionals.

rules.rule: Display course, learner identity, deadline, submission status, grading status, feedback source, attempt count, saved state, and audience visibility beside every submission, grading, or visibility action.
rules.rationale: Decision context must be visible at the moment of commitment.
rules.failureMode: Missing context causes an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Show course/class name in the same visual group as the primary action.
rules.rationale: The highest-risk identifier must travel with the action.
rules.failureMode: The user acts without seeing course/class name.

rules.rule: Label data freshness or status whenever the view contains learner content, teacher rosters, grading tables, assessments, and progress views.
rules.rationale: Users must know whether operational data is current.
rules.failureMode: The interface hides stale context around learner content, teacher rosters, grading tables, assessments, and progress views.

rules.rule: Require a review step before assignment submit, quiz close, grade release, visibility change, deletion, and roster update.
rules.rationale: High-cost actions need an interruption for verification.
rules.failureMode: The user completes assignment submit, quiz close, grade release, visibility change, deletion, and roster update without review.

rules.rule: Block silent changes to critical values after review in submission, grading, or visibility action.
rules.rationale: Consent depends on the reviewed values staying stable.
rules.failureMode: The UI allows an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Provide a recovery or correction path when an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.
rules.rationale: High-cost mistakes need visible next steps.
rules.failureMode: The user cannot recover after an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Match density to learner content, teacher rosters, grading tables, assessments, and progress views; do not use decorative spacing that separates labels from values.
rules.rationale: Domain work depends on scanning related facts together.
rules.failureMode: Related labels and values drift apart visually.

rules.rule: Keep required identifiers visible at mobile widths for submission, grading, or visibility action.
rules.rationale: Narrow screens are common at decision time.

rules.rule: Do not use decorative motion around progress, quiz feedback, grading, submission, or learner status changes.
rules.rationale: Motion must not hide or trivialize domain state.
rules.failureMode: Motion obscures an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Provide a reduced-motion path for status changes involving draft-saved-not-submitted, deadline-grace, resubmission-locked, offline-draft-queue, feedback-pending, accommodation-available, role-switch, and low-bandwidth-media-failure.
rules.rationale: State meaning must survive user motion preferences.

rules.rule: Ask a qualified professional: Which users are minors, and what consent or guardian access applies?
rules.rationale: This is orientation only; requirements vary by jurisdiction.
rules.failureMode: The team assumes compliance without validating: Which users are minors, and what consent or guardian access applies?

rules.rule: Ask a qualified professional: What student records are protected and who may see them?
rules.rationale: This is orientation only; requirements vary by jurisdiction.
rules.failureMode: The team assumes compliance without validating: What student records are protected and who may see them?

rules.rule: Ask a qualified professional: Which accessibility standards govern course content and assessments?
rules.rationale: This is orientation only; requirements vary by jurisdiction.
rules.failureMode: The team assumes compliance without validating: Which accessibility standards govern course content and assessments?

rules.rule: Use exact labels for submitted, draft, processing, returned, graded, attempt, deadline timezone, accommodation, transcript, and audience.
rules.failureMode: A generic label causes an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Define ambiguous values as saved draft, submitted, processing, returned, graded, resubmission open, locked, provisional, and final.
rules.rationale: Users should not infer whether values are final or provisional.
rules.failureMode: A provisional value is treated as final in submission, grading, or visibility action.

rules.rule: Provide states for draft-saved-not-submitted, deadline-grace, resubmission-locked, offline-draft-queue, feedback-pending, accommodation-available, role-switch, and low-bandwidth-media-failure.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Preserve user input or task context when recovery is needed after submission, grading, or visibility action.
rules.rationale: Recovery without preserved context still fails the task.
rules.failureMode: The user must restart after an assignment says submitted when upload is still processing.

rules.rule: Expose an empty or unavailable state that explains whether learner content, teacher rosters, grading tables, assessments, and progress views are absent, filtered, stale, or permission denied.
rules.rationale: Empty states need cause and next action.
rules.failureMode: Users cannot distinguish absent data from hidden data.

rules.rule: Keep course/class name visible in confirmation and receipt states.
rules.rationale: Receipts are evidence and recovery anchors.
